snippet.title: News Tower - Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
🌎 News Tower's 1.0 Release is coming November 04!  📰
💌 Get it on Steam 25% off until August 28 ➡ http://bit.ly/NewsTower

Step into the newsroom and get ready—News Tower version 1.0 arrives November 4! Build your newspaper empire in 1930s new York City: juggle factions, outsmart rival publishers, keep your staff in line, and shape public perception in a dynamic tycoon-strategy experience.

Don’t miss your shot at the top—run the headlines, rule the city.

Wishlist now for updates!

📑 Key features: 
📰 Rival Papers, Real Competition – Outsmart competing publishers and fight for every subscriber.
🤝 Powerful Factions, Real Consequences – Build alliances or face resistance in 1930s NYC politics.
🧠 Perception is Power – Shape your readers' views while managing staff demands and press deadlines.


👉 Join the community on Discord: https://discord.gg/3MwVhgqtea
👉 Keep up to date on Twitter: https://x.com/NewsTowerGame
